terms.name: HMAS

terms.name: Lisp image
terms.definition: A Lisp environment with its loaded program code and runtime data. See [What is a Lisp image?](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/480083/what-is-a-lisp-image).

sources.quote: Autolith runs in a live Common Lisp image.

terms.name: Simplified Technical English
terms.definition: A controlled form of English with writing rules and a dictionary for technical documentation. See [ASD-STE100, Issue 9 (January 2025)](https://asd-ste100.org/STE_downloads.html), the original specification (free copy by request).

sources.quote: New prose uses Simplified Technical English.

terms.name: Principal component analysis
terms.definition: A linear projection of centered data onto orthogonal directions of greatest variance.

sources.quote: Use exact reduced SVD, with no per-dimension standardization or whitening.
Refit PCA on each build, so positions can change.
